title: Assert pre-state in dao_route_makes_address_outside_0202_local test
description: P3 (wave-2 review of worker6-fz2c): rust/lichen-gateway/src/gateway.rs test dao_route_makes_address_outside_0202_local (~:2115) injects a route for 0201::1 and asserts is_local_mesh == true, but never asserts !is_local_mesh BEFORE injection. If a future regression made all 02xx addresses local by default, the test would still pass. Fix: add assert!(!gw.is_local_mesh(&node_addr)); before inject_route.
